svg.text: CONDITIONAL ENVELOPE CAD / NOT FOR MANUFACTURING

g.text: motor X → selector X → PTO INWARD_X_INDEPENDENT | right-angle 0 | bearings 8 | common pattern, never a common physical left-right shaft
motor X → selector X → PTO INWARD_X_INDEPENDENT | right-angle 0 | bearings 12 | separate DRIVE/PTO jackshaft candidates
motor Y → selector X → PTO INWARD_X_INDEPENDENT | right-angle 1 | bearings 12 | one explicit bevel pair per side
motor Y → selector Y → PTO FORWARD_NEGATIVE_Y_INDEPENDENT | right-angle 1 | bearings 10 | PTO remains Y; DRIVE branch alone uses bevel
motor Z → selector X → PTO INWARD_X_INDEPENDENT | right-angle 1 | bearings 10 | vertical motor requires explicit bevel
motor FUTURE_PRODUCT → selector X_OR_Y → PTO PRODUCT_SELECTION_HOLD | right-angle 1 | bearings 8 | envelope-only future comparison; PURCHASE_HOLD
